name: office-form-pdf-system
description: Internal office form system for worker ID login, AL form PDF generation, and calendar view.

scripts.check: python -B -c "import pathlib; files=list(pathlib.Path('app').glob('*.py'))+[pathlib.Path('app_entry.py')]+list(pathlib.Path('scripts').glob('*.py')); [compile(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), str(p), 'exec') for p in files]; print('Python syntax OK')"
